title: What Happens to Your Body If You Stop Showering (Day by Day, Counted)

scenes.say: Every minute, about thirty thousand of your skin cells fall off. Normally, a shower washes them away. So what happens if you just... stop?
No soap. No water. Day by day. Counted.
Day one. You look fine. But you've already shed more than forty million skin cells. And the bacteria on your skin just got a feast.
And that number never stops. By the end of the first week, it's around three hundred million cells, mixing with oil and sweat.
Here's the strange part. Your sweat barely smells at all. The smell comes from bacteria breaking it down. And by now, they're everywhere.

visual.label: DAYS WITHOUT A SHOWER
visual.note: the odor is made by bacteria

scenes.say: And after a month? You'll have shed about one point three billion skin cells. Let's count what happens to every one of them.
